description: Sample ESP32 telemetry data format for Honeycomb FRC Dashboard

speed.description: Current robot speed in meters per second

esp32_arduino_code_example.description: Example Arduino code for ESP32 to send telemetry data

connection_instructions.step_1: Upload the Arduino code to your ESP32
connection_instructions.step_2: Connect ESP32 to your WiFi network
connection_instructions.step_3: Note the ESP32's IP address from Serial Monitor
connection_instructions.step_4: Update the IP address in the dashboard if different from 192.168.1.100
connection_instructions.step_5: Click 'Connect ESP32' button in the dashboard header
connection_instructions.step_6: Charts will start updating with real ESP32 data

troubleshooting.connection_failed: Check ESP32 IP address and WiFi connection
troubleshooting.no_data: Verify WebSocket server is running on ESP32
troubleshooting.charts_not_updating: Check browser console for WebSocket errors
troubleshooting.wrong_data_format: Ensure ESP32 sends JSON in the correct format
